lines.text: I see that you set free an Arialien.
Like the blue Clims, breaking cages is very important.
Indeed, for each broken cage, the Arialien jailed will give you 10 of them.
In this world, you have to set free 7 Arialiens. Indeed, you can win 70 of the 161 Clims.
Without forgetting that the Arialiens can give you one life supplementary.
